description: Gefahrenzonen BWV Tirol is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by dservices3.arcgis.com. Danger zones of the Federal Water Engineering Administration (BWV). Pursuant to Section 42a of the WRG 1959, flood hazard maps must be drawn up and displayed. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Danger zones BWV Tirol" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include überschwemmung, tirol, tyrol, HighValueDataset, wasserwirtschaft, tiris. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WFS, HTML, PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
